node.label: mucopolysaccharidosis type 6
node.definition: Mucopolysaccharidosis type 6 (MPS 6) is a lysosomal storage disease with progressive multisystem involvement, associated with a deficiency of arylsulfatase B (ASB) leading to the accumulation of dermatan sulfate.

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)

evidence.snippet: ARSB is annotated as disease gene of OMIM:253200 (HPO genes_to_phenotype, OMIM-derived)

Congenital deficiencies of arylsulfatases, especially A (ARSA) and B (ARSB), can induce metabolic disorders such as metachromatic leucodystrophy (ARSA deficiency) and Maroteaux-Lamy syndrome (ARSB deficiency).
